entities.name: Latulla
entities.description: A Keldon warrior skilled in artifice, the Doyenne in charge of the Keldon invasion of Jamuraa; she died in battle at Barrin's hands.

entities.name: Haddad
entities.description: Kipamu officer captured and enslaved by Latulla.

entities.name: Gorsha
entities.description: Servant of the Warlords' Council who defeated Latulla in ritual combat.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Enraged by Rayne's death, he decapitated Latulla.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Warrior nation led by warlords whose women play a prominent role.

entities.name: Kipamu League
entities.description: Force defending Jamuraa whose war machines Latulla captured.

entities.name: Witch Kings
entities.description: Beings Latulla hoped to awaken for the Prophesied Keldon Twilight.

entities.name: Keldon Necropolis
entities.description: Place where Latulla was refused entry.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Continent on Dominaria invaded by Keldons.

entities.name: Prophecy War
entities.description: Keldon invasion of Jamuraa commanded by Latulla.

events.summary: Latulla rises to prominence, expelling the master of her house and taking over his faction.
events.quote: reportedly expelling the master of her house and taking over his faction

events.summary: Latulla is placed in command of the Prophecy War and takes the captive Kipamu officer Haddad as her slave.
events.quote: she took the captive Kipamu officer Haddad as her slave

events.summary: Latulla returns to Keld to push the warlords to awaken the Witch Kings, but is defeated in ritual combat by Gorsha at the Keldon Necropolis and exiled with her supporters.
events.quote: Latulla and her supporters were exiled from Keld to fight and die in foreign lands

events.summary: Latulla's counterattack against the Kipamu League fails; pinned under a war barge, she is decapitated by Barrin, who she mistook for a slave.
events.quote: Barrin, enraged by Rayne 's death, instead decapitated her
